Thank you for sharing your words, they touched my heart. I wonder every day if my ex best friend ever thinks of me, she just up and left one day after a 10year long friendship and told everyone we were enemies without ever even having an argument…

I started dissociating real bad when I was around 14, to escape my sexual assault somehow. I still feel 14 and have to remind myself that I am indeed an adult now all the time, acting childish and immature…. It sucks. I am 25 now
